**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

## Episode Thesis

Macro-focused Di episode covering the Riksbank's decision to hold the policy rate at 1.75%. The analysts read it as hawkish: the new rate path was raised by about 0.41 percentage points and signals a hike before year-end, with 2-3 more by 2028. Behind this are higher KPIF inflation forecasts, a weaker krona, GDP growth revised up to 2.8%, the Strait of Hormuz oil shock and moderate wage-bargaining expectations. No individual stocks were discussed, so the only company mentions are sponsors, media outlets and a bank cited for a forecast.
